title: •Dreaded Imperial Starfleet
caption: •Dreaded Imperial Starfleet (V)
game_text: Deploy on table. While you have more systems on table than opponent, your capital starships deploy -2 (to a minimum of 3) to battlegrounds. When you deploy an _Imperial_-Class Star Destroyer, may ▼ (for free) a {set:ds2} or {set:anh} squadron there (no replacement is necessary). {alter}
lore: The Empire uses short-range fighters and patrol craft to maintain a presence in every system within its scope of power.

notes: Unique. Banner EFFECT, no grabber box. '_Imperial_-Class' italic as printed. Two inline expansion icons: 'a [silver sphere, blue/red diagonal reflections] or [silver sphere, crossed red and white diagonals] squadron' → {set:ds2} and {set:anh} (matched against assets/icons/set-ds2-grainy.png and set-anh-grainy.png; GEMP's Virtual Block 4 text reads '[Death Star II] or [A New Hope] squadron', and the Dark squadrons are The Emperor's Shield/Sword (DS2) and TIE Assault Squadron (ANH)). The wiki stub drops the second icon and names the first 'TIE' ('a TIE or squadron') — stub differs. The text layer has 'may▼' with no space; the slip image shows a small gap, so 'may ▼' is used. Red circle-slash A at the end → {alter}. Lore matches the scan. Base scan only at 350 px. Copyright line not legible on the 350 px scan; set-convention form. Modern: Virtual Block 4 only (VB4 -pre, 350 px; its text is older wording).
